summary: Wing Yip Food Holdings Group Limited filed a Form 6-K on August 31, 2026, solely to disclose its submission of an interim report for the six months ended June 30, 2026 to the Korea Exchange (KRX), as required by KRX listing rules. This is a routine regulatory compliance filing by a foreign private issuer, providing access to its interim financial statements. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or management change is involved. The filing is informational and not a special-situation event, thus categorized as None.
